events.title: Tribute to Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was shot in a drive-by shooting in Las Vegas on September 7, 1996, and died six days later on September 13, 1996, at the age of 25.

angles.name: Remembering Tupac
angles.copy: Thirty years since his untimely passing, we're remembering the enduring impact of Tupac Shakur. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix died on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Jimi Hendrix today. His influence on music is still felt decades on. What's your go-to Hendrix riff?

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released in the UK on September 26, 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Memories
angles.copy: Celebrating an album that changed everything! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' was released this week in '69. Which track is on repeat for you?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, was born on September 7, 1951, and turns 75 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Sending happy birthday wishes to the incredible Chrissie Hynde, who turns 75 today! What's your favourite Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Liam Gallagher, the iconic frontman of Oasis, was born on September 21, 1972, and celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy Birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: Imagine Album Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's seminal solo album 'Imagine' was released on September 9, 1971, in the US and October 8, 1971, in the UK.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since its release, John Lennon's 'Imagine' album continues to inspire. What does this powerful record mean to you?

events.title: Original iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod on October 23, 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? It launched 25 years ago this month, changing how we listened to music forever. What was on your first playlist?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day
events.blurb: October 5th is celebrated annually as James Bond Day, marking the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to thrilling car chases, what's your all-time favourite 007 moment or theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: John Lennon, co-founder of The Beatles, was born on October 9, 1940, and would have been 86 today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to resonate globally. What's his most important legacy?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: British comedy legend John Cleese was born on October 27, 1939, and celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! What's your favourite Monty Python or Fawlty Towers sketch?

events.title: White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album Deep Dive
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since 'The White Album' dropped! A sprawling masterpiece from The Beatles. Which deep cut is your favourite?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Freddie Mercury, the iconic lead singer of Queen, died on November 24, 1991, at the age of 45.

angles.name: Freddie's Timeless Voice
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled showmanship and voice of Freddie Mercury today. His legacy with Queen truly lives on.

events.title: Rubber Soul Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on December 3, 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul's Impact
angles.copy: Celebrating an album that marked a turning point for The Beatles – 'Rubber Soul' was released this week in '65. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: John Lennon was tragically shot and killed in New York City on December 8, 1980, at the age of 40.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Message
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost a true visionary. Remembering John Lennon's profound impact on music and peace today.
